result_claim: The inclusion of the induced-bipartite vertex-set complex into the induced-triangle-free vertex-set complex of the icosahedral graph is a twelve-pair simplicial collapse, and both complexes have homotopy type \(M(\mathbb Z/2,4)\). The bipartite complex is a connected nonorientable pure five-dimensional pseudomanifold with one hundred facets.
scientific_integrity: Exact finite computer-assisted derivation using exhaustive subsets, acyclic discrete Morse pairing, integer gradient reduction, and independent modular chain ranks. No independent external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the twelve-vertex icosahedral graph is classified.
Unindexed prior coverage cannot be ruled out.
The complete Jonsson book chapters were not accessible, so their precise contents were not certified.
The pseudomanifold need not be a combinatorial manifold.
title: A Moore space from odd-cycle-independent subsets of the icosahedral graph
